Flip questions

What is the cheapest Flip NBN plan?

Premium NBN 25/10 at $48/mo for 12 months, then $65.90/mo. That is $576 over the first year (checked 10 October 2026).

Does Flip let you opt out of CGNAT?

Not for free. Flip only offers a public IP through a paid static IP add-on.

Do you need to give Flip 30 days notice to cancel?

No. Flip doesn't require a 30-day notice period to cancel.

Has Flip raised its prices recently?

We haven't recorded any ongoing price rises for Flip since 31 July 2026. Promo prices have changed; see the table above.
